title: Neural Calibration of a Complete Market Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.30867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a neural calibration method to construct a recombining binomial tree directly from a set of given option prices. Rather than estimating a continuous option pricing function or a local volatility surface as an intermediate object, a neural network is used to deform a benchmark lattice. This leads to a discrete pricing model which is guaranteed to be arbitrage-free, complete, easy to interpret, and can be used directly for pricing and to find replicating trading strategies. Calibration is formulated as a penalized optimization problem that combines a repricing error with an admissibility penalty, and an optional spatial regularization term based on implied local volatilities. Numerical experiments on synthetic and SPX market data show that the proposed approach yields accurate repricing and is very competitive when compared to recently proposed other neural calibration methods. It preserves the computational advantages of lattic

translated_title: 完全市场模型的神经网络校准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种神经网络校准方法，可以直接从一组给定的期权价格构建重组二叉树。该方法并非以估计连续期权定价函数或局部波动率曲面作为中间目标，而是利用神经网络对基准格点进行变形。由此得到的离散定价模型可保证无套利、市场完全、易于解释，并可直接用于定价以及寻找复制交易策略。校准被表述为一个带惩罚项的优化问题，将重定价误差与可容许性惩罚相结合，并可选择加入基于隐含局部波动率的空间正则化项。在合成数据与SPX市场数据上的数值实验表明，所提方法能够实现精确的重定价，与近期提出的其他神经网络校准方法相比具有很强的竞争力，同时保留了格点模型的计算优势。
tldr: 提出一种神经网络校准方法，通过变形基准二叉格点直接从期权价格构建无套利、市场完全的离散定价模型，可直接用于期权定价与复制交易策略的求解。
en_tdlr: A neural calibration method that deforms a benchmark binomial lattice to directly construct arbitrage-free, complete discrete market models from given option prices, enabling direct pricing and replicating strategy computation.
